[[Kole's Torment]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[The Darkness (boss)|The Darknesses (boss)]] who can be found in [[The Hall of Heroes|The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Blood Magic]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge of spells]] (Chance: 20%)
:[[HCT|Halves casting time of spells]] (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses a similar [[skin]] as the [[Shadow Staff]] except it has a green eye instead of a blue eye.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following Blood Magic staves:
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Spinal Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "Don't Think Twice" [[inscription]]

==Unique counterpart==
[[Zoldark's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Soul Reaping]].

==Trivia==
The Darknesses stole this staff from the tomb of [[King Kole]].
